title: Ro Ro Kehti Thi Baanoe Dukhya
body:
ro ro kehti thi baanoe dukhya, aao asghar tumhaari bala loo'n
tera laasha hai laasho'n me kis jaa, aao asghar tumhaari bala loo'n
<<DIVIDER>>
dhoondti hu tumhei'n mere jaani, ho kahaa'n mere yousufe saani
pyaas me tumne paaya na paani, aao asghar tumhaari bala loo'n
<<DIVIDER>>
Ab kahaa'n se kaho tum ko laaoo'n, lori de de kise ab sunaaoo'n
kiske jhoole ki dori hilaaoo'n, aao asghar tumhaari bala loo'n
<<DIVIDER>>
halq par teere bedaad dhaaye, khoon me sar se paa tak nahaaye
khoob jungle me aaraam paaye, aao asghar tumhaari bala loo'n
<<DIVIDER>>
nanha sa sar sina par chadha hai, kunba sar nange rota khada hai
jhoola khaali tumhaara pada hai, aao asghar tumhaari bala loo'n
<<DIVIDER>>
Aao ae jaane maadar ab aao, god khaali hai aakar basaao
kahee'n jungle me tum dar na jaao, aao asghar tumhaari bala loo'n
